title: FSI-AgentGov Solution Control Coverage
description: Per-solution control-coverage export. Generated identity/version/control-list fields are refreshed by build-manifest.py from manifest.yaml; authored coverageScope, per-control notes, and declared partial coverage are preserved across regeneration. Consumed by the framework solutions-lock.json contract.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version for this export format.

generatedBy.description: Build script that produced this file.

solutionId.description: Canonical solution ID (matches manifest.yaml id and folder name).

coverageScope.description: Optional authored coverage-scope rationale preserved by build-manifest.py. Common keys include summary, reference, planeCovered, and gaps.

coverage.description: Coverage level. Defaults to full when not overridden in manifest.yaml.

notes.description: Optional authored per-control evidence or gap rationale preserved by build-manifest.py.

controls.description: Framework controls implemented by this solution with coverage level.

controlCount.description: Total number of controls covered (convenience field).
